newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends higher in dull market.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends higher in dull market.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka maintained its edge and closed higher at 43.7350/7450 to the dollar in dull interbank trading, dealers said.

The taka opened higher at 43.7350/7450 against the previous close at 43.7470/7490. Dealers said the local unit remained strong on lower demand for dollars due to weekend closure of most international markets.
The interbank call money rates closed lower at 7.75 percent to 8.75 percent against the previous 7.75-9.5 percent.
